title: Gaze World Model
abstract: arXiv:2611.31836v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Where a person looks indicates their focus of attention, and how their gaze shifts between targets reveals how that attention responds to a changing scene. Existing gaze target estimation methods largely operate frame by frame and do not model these shifts. Gaze shifts are often driven by dynamic changes in the scene, which is the kind of information world models are designed to encode. This relationship is subtle, however, since an event far across the frame may produce only a slight movement of the person's head or eyes. We therefore introduce the Gaze World Model (GWM), which co-trains latent scene prediction with person-conditioned gaze supervision on a frozen V-JEPA 2.1 encoder; in our ablations, the latent prediction objective improves both shift detection and gaze localization. translated_abstract: 一个人看向哪里表明了其注意力的焦点，而其目光在不同目标之间如何转移，则揭示了其注意力如何回应不断变化的场景。现有的注视目标估计方法大多逐帧运行，并未对这些注视转移进行建模。注视转移通常由场景中的动态变化所驱动，而这正是世界模型被设计用来编码的那类信息。然而这种关系较为微妙，因为发生在画面远处的事件可能只会引起人物头部或眼睛的轻微移动。为此，我们提出了注视世界模型，该模型在冻结的 V-JEPA 2.1 编码器上，将潜在场景预测与以人物为条件的注视监督进行联合训练；在我们的消融实验中，潜在预测目标同时提升了注视转移检测和注视定位的性能。给定一段视频片段和人物头部边界框，GWM 可以估计注视位置、检测所观察片段中的注视转移，并预测未来的注视和注（视转移）。
tldr: 提出注视世界模型（GWM），在冻结的 V-JEPA 2.1 编码器上将潜在场景预测与人物条件化的注视监督联合训练，实现注视定位、注视转移检测以及未来注视变化预测。
en_tdlr: Introduces the Gaze World Model (GWM), which co-trains latent scene prediction with person-conditioned gaze supervision on a frozen V-JEPA 2.1 encoder, enabling gaze localization, gaze shift detection, and forecasting of future gaze and shifts.
